name: plc_online_connect
description: Connect to a real Siemens PLC over S7CommPlus to read online values. The connection stays open across calls until plc_online_disconnect. Works with S7-1200 and S7-1500 CPUs reachable on TCP port 102: TLS for projects from TIA Portal V17 or later, legacy challenge login for older ones; no TIA Portal needed. Read-only.

address.description: IP address or host name of the PLC, e.g. '192.168.0.10'.

password.description: Optional PLC access-protection password; only needed when the CPU's protection level requires one for reading.

username.description: Optional user name for CPUs using user management (TIA V19+); leave empty otherwise.

timeout_ms.description: Connection and response timeout in milliseconds, 1000-60000. Default 8000.

security_mode.description: 'auto' (default: try TLS, fall back to legacy login), 'tls' (TIA V17+ projects only) or 'legacy' (TIA V16 and older).
